Name: Dino Form 2
Author: juminos
Description:
This is a rework of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18244]aedenthorn's Dino Form[/url] mod updated for 1.6

Main differences from the original:

1. no longer requires the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17746]Buff Framework[/url] mod

2. new trigger for transformation

3. new barn animal version of Pepper Rex (including products that provide the transformation trigger)*

4. works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22094]Ilucie's Pepper Rex (for 1.6)[/url] (optional but highly recommended; this mod makes some changes, see below)**

5. configurable transformation duration ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] recommended)

*The new barn version of Pepper Rex can be obtained in a similar manner as the coop dinosaur (use barn incubator) but eggs may be a bit harder to find

**When using this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22094]Ilucie's Pepper Rex (for 1.6)[/url]﻿ the Pepper Rex animals will no longer show up in the shop, but a new method for obtaining them is added to the game (see previous note)


As I was updating aedenthorn's code for 1.6 compatibility, I removed and altered some of it, but the main transformation components are still largely aedenthorn's original work. See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18244]Dino Form[/url] mod page for more information and the original mod code.

Manifest.Description: Adds Pepper Rex as a barn animal.
